records.name: Mack Plumblow
records.biography_en: Mack once filed a drawing of a repaired HyperNorm wall as evidence that the repair had been completed.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: The wall disagreed. Its objection is with Planning.

records.name: Gus Bitlock
records.biography_en: Gus drills out anything HyperNorm has classified as a structural contradiction.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: When I asked for a quieter answer, he handed me the ear defenders.

records.name: Mara Jointline
records.biography_en: Mara was summoned to repair a wall with an awkward gap in its official history. She laid a neat course over the footnote.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: Her mortar is the only part of the report that has set.

records.name: Ned Bucketturn
records.biography_en: Ned dug up the foundations of a HyperNorm office that was still officially under construction.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: He put them back in the same hole, which was accepted as continuity.

records.name: Tess Truepoint
records.biography_en: HyperNorm moved a boundary overnight. Tess returned at dawn and measured exactly how far the explanation had travelled.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: Her original mark is still there. The boundary is considering an appeal.

records.name: Otto Sawline
records.biography_en: Otto builds temporary screens to hide damage while the official story dries. He leaves a little breathing room.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: I asked whether the screens were permanent. He said only the temporary ones were.
